test_read_file_tool: test the read_file_tool function that reads file content with optional offset and limit parameters
test_write_file_tool: test the write_file_tool function that writes string content to a file path
test_patch_tool_replace_mode: test the patch_tool function in replace mode to substitute old_string with new_string in a file
test_patch_tool_patch_mode: test the patch_tool function in patch mode to apply a unified diff patch string to a file
